different utility commodity and no electricity or telecom operations."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Electrical contractor installing and maintaining systems for customers, not owning and operating power or telecom networks."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Water and wastewater utility with municipal contract operations; no electric or telecom business in common."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Gas-only distribution utility with appliance service plans; lacks the target's electricity generation and telecom services."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Small natural gas and propane distributor delivering fuel, not generating electricity or providing telecom services."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Rural and suburban telecom provider offering internet, voice and video over its own fiber and telephone networks, like the target."},{"label":"C14","good":true,"reason":"Telecom operator serving rural and small-town markets with wireless, broadband and phone services over owned networks."},{"label":"C15","good":true,"reason":"Regulated electric utility with generation, transmission and distribution serving residential and business customers."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Mainly a leasing owner of fiber and copper networks to carriers, a real estate-style business rather than a utility operator."}]}
